continuity_note: Rejected: the |Gamma_I| = |Gamma_II| crossover spans 2.47e+06x in K across the SMBH/migrator grid, so no single global threshold makes the Type-I -> Type-II switch continuous.
recommendation_basis: K = 25 is the point at which this model's own gap-depth law, Sigma_gap/Sigma_0 = 1/(1+0.04K), reaches one half.  It is the only value in the family that is fixed by the model itself rather than chosen: it is the same kappa_norm the Type-I torque already uses.  No external calibration was possible offline.
residual_judgement: Whether 'gap open' should mean 50 per cent or 10 per cent depletion is a modelling choice this repository cannot settle.  The sensitivity tables record what changes if it is revised.
